purpose: Define optional per-resource reauthentication with explicit assurance requirement, allowed authentication methods, resource-specific lifetime and key/session rotation.

topics.name: AccessCore Reauthentication
topics.purpose: Define optional per-resource reauthentication with explicit assurance requirement, allowed authentication methods, resource-specific lifetime and key/session rotation.

operations.name: Resolve resource reauthentication requirement
outputs: required assurance + allowed auth methods + lifetime

semantics.success_rule: Successful reauthentication creates a resource-specific bounded grant.
semantics.rotation_rule: Successful reauthentication rotates applicable keys/session material according to the resource policy.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Reauth lifetime is resource-specific and finite where enabled.
semantics.separation_rule: Reauthentication raises/refreshes assurance for the scoped resource; it does not create unrelated authorization.
semantics.fallback_rule: Failure does not silently fall back to weaker assurance.

invariants.rule: Identity assurance, authorization, remote delegation and activation state remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: reauth success grants unrelated resource rights
resource reauth lifetime unbounded when policy requires expiry
reauth failure silently downgrades to weaker method
allowed authentication methods inferred instead of explicit
resource-specific grant reused outside its scope

references.purpose: Reauth validates explicit IAM assurance levels.
Reauth complements but does not replace authorization.

prose.summary: Define optional per-resource reauthentication with explicit assurance requirement, allowed authentication methods, resource-specific lifetime and key/session rotation.
